newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks cut losses after U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: French stocks cut losses after U.S. data.

text.p: French shares cut their losses and briefly went into the black after a rise in U.S. bonds and French share futures on the back of an upward revision to U.S. third quarter GDP, dealers said.
But the market returned to the red when Wall Street slipped after a U.S. durable goods figure, wiping out the initial gains.
Truck strike worries still on investors' mind but government mediator said agreement had been found on two main points.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was down 1.03 points or 0.05 percent at 2,274.05 at 2451 GMT while the CAC-40 futures contract was up one at 2,276.
